title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 12
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that all men under his charge
options: All the men work at their own chosen pace
They start the work before the shift examination of the day
They decide their own work places in mine
Are properly briefed about the day's work and hazards
questions.solution: Workers must be briefed about the day's work and hazards.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine section' shows
options: The horizontal extent of the whole underground mine workings
The surface features of the mine only
Vertical slice through the mine showing workings
The tonnage of the coal at one place
questions.solution: Mine sections show vertical slices through workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The live-line working in mines is
options: It is always permitted in the whole of the underground mine workings
Generally prohibited except under special circumstances
It is never permitted in the coal mine area
It is required at all the shift times here
questions.solution: Generally prohibited except under special circumstances.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'leakage' in ventilation occurs through
options: Remove harmful gases and dust
The roof strata of the mine only
Stoppings, doors, and other openings
There is no any leakage at all
questions.solution: Ventilation leakage occurs through stoppings, doors, openings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The signaling system for man riding must include
options: A single large bell at the mine surface area
Hand signals from the mine driver of the area
Silence at all the underground mine boarding and landing stations
Clearly audible signals at all boarding and landing points
questions.solution: Clearly audible signals at all points are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: While examining opencast workings, the sirdar must check the highwall and bench edges for:
options: Overhangs and any obstruction, staying at least 3 m away from the edge
The bottom benches of the surface open cast mine pit
The presence of all the mine vehicles in the working face area here
The quality of the coal seams of the whole mine area here
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129 (opencast duties): the sirdar examines highwall/bench edges for overhangs and loose material, keeping at least 3 m from the edge.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'easier breakage' in drifting is achieved by
options: Proper drill pattern, burden, and spacing
The use of many more explosives
The much longer drill rods only
A much wetter underground drift face
questions.solution: Proper drill patterns achieve easier breakage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'unsafe condition' in a mine includes
options: The well maintained machinery of the mine area
The fresh ventilation and the mine lighting in the whole mine area here
The regular safety inspections of the mine area
Defective equipment, inadequate ventilation, and poor lighting
questions.solution: Defective equipment, inadequate ventilation, and poor lighting.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum permissible noise level for continuous exposure in mines is
options: 95 dB
90 dB
85 dB
80 dB
questions.solution: Maximum 85 dB for continuous exposure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'proximate analysis' of coal determines
options: The moisture held in the coal seam area
The ultimate elemental composition only
The sulphur retained after the burning of the mine coal
Moisture, volatile matter, ash, and fixed carbon
questions.solution: Proximate analysis determines moisture, VM, ash, FC.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'inundation emergency plan' includes
options: No any such emergency plan is needed in the mine working areas here
Evacuation procedures, pumping activation, and communication
The deployment of the extra mine haulage plant
The arrangement of the extra mine timber sets
questions.solution: Emergency plans include evacuation, pumping, communication.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum speed of a man riding rope haulage system should not exceed
options: 1 m/s
5 m/s
3 m/s
2 m/s
questions.solution: The maximum speed should not exceed 3 m/s as per regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'dust sampler' in coal mines is used to
options: To sample the mine air gas
Collect airborne dust for analysis
To sample the coal seam dust
To sample the mine water flow
questions.solution: Dust samplers collect airborne dust for concentration analysis.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'coal fire' in an open cast mine can be caused by
options: The extraction of the coal below the deep mine water table levels here
The water in the underground mine workings of the whole coal mine area
The continuous heavy rainfall on the surface mine spoil heap
Improper handling of explosives, equipment heat, or spontaneous combustion
questions.solution: Improper handling of explosives, equipment heat, or spontaneous combustion.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the manager must ensure that
options: A single large pump at the surface mine pit bottom
The pumping arrangements are made only in the rainy season of the year
Adequate pumping arrangements are maintained to prevent inundation
No pumping arrangements at all are needed in the mine
questions.solution: Adequate pumping arrangements must be maintained.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When a sirdar detects water accumulation, he must
options: To wait for the mine manager there
To record it in the annual mine report
Report immediately and stop work if dangerous
To wait till the next mine shift only
questions.solution: Immediate reporting and stopping work if dangerous is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'hydraulic stowing pipeline' must be made of
options: Any material of the good quality in the mine area here
The plain wooden pipes of the mine area
The copper tubes of the mine area only
Wear-resistant material to handle abrasive slurry
questions.solution: Pipelines must be wear-resistant for abrasive slurry.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'vehicle proximity detection system' helps to
options: Alert operators of nearby vehicles, prevent collisions
To increase the operating speed of trucks
To reduce the fuel consumption of trucks
To improve the aesthetics of the whole open cast mine area here
questions.solution: Proximity systems alert operators to prevent collisions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'pilot raise' is driven to
options: To improve the lighting of the mine area
Establish a raise connection between two levels
To provide a sump for the mine water
To store the mine explosives in the raise
questions.solution: Establishes a raise connection between two levels.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Primer cartridges in shot firing are
options: Small charges to initiate main charge
They are used for the stemming of it
They are the mine safety devices
They are the largest charges used in it
questions.solution: Primers are small charges to initiate the main explosive column.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'floor' of a coal seam is the
options: Rock layer directly below the coal seam
The rock layer above the coal seam
The soil layer on the surface
The coal seam layer by itself
questions.solution: Floor is the rock directly below the coal seam.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Before commencing work, the sirdar must
options: Wait for the manager's call
To check only the mine roof
To start the blasting immediately
Inspect the working place for safety
questions.solution: The sirdar must inspect the working place for safety before commencing work.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A continuous miner is operated from
options: By a lever at the working face
By the mine fan man there only
A remote control from a safe distance
By the surface control room only
questions.solution: Operated by remote control from a safe distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding engine must be capable of being operated from
options: Both the winding house and the shaft bottom if required
From the surface of the whole open cast coal mine area here
By the mine banksman on duty at the pit bottom
During an emergency of the mine winding house
questions.solution: From both the winding house and shaft bottom if required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal measurement' by survey determines
options: The grade of coal in the seam floor
The thickness of the overburden
Volume and tonnage of coal extracted
The price realised per tonne of coal
questions.solution: Coal measurement determines volume and tonnage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'door' in ventilation is used to
options: To block the air flow of the airway
Allow passage while controlling air flow
To measure the quantity of the air
To increase the air velocity of it
questions.solution: Ventilation doors allow passage while controlling air.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Winding in shafts is regulated by
options: CMR 2017 Regulation 136
Mines Act 1952 only
Indian Railways Act
Factory Act
questions.solution: Winding in shafts is regulated by CMR 2017 Regulation 136.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a shot-firer shall not be employed:
options: Without the mine assistant of any competent person working in the mine
On any work which makes his earnings depend on the amount of coal produced
On the night shifts of the whole underground coal mine workings areas only
In more than one of the underground working sections here
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 190: a shot-firer shall not be employed on work dependent on the quantity of coal/mineral produced, to avoid haste.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An earth continuity tester is used to
options: The measurement of the insulation resistance of all the mine windings
The measurement of the air velocity in the mine roadways
Check the continuity of earth connections in electrical installations
The measurement of the frequency of the mine power supply
questions.solution: Checks continuity of earth connections.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety measures against roof fall include
options: Proper support, regular inspection, and strata monitoring
Increasing the height of the mine coal pillar
Reducing the number of the regular inspections
Increasing the underground mine ventilation fan speed in the area
questions.solution: Proper support, regular inspection, and strata monitoring.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'chain pillar' in board and pillar mining serves to
options: To store the mine explosives in it
To provide the mine ventilation in it
To increase the coal extraction in mine
Support the roof between adjacent galleries
questions.solution: Chain pillars support the roof between adjacent galleries.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A '3D laser scanning' in mine surveying is used to
options: Measuring the width of all the mine roadways of the mine area
To test the stability of the mine roof area
Create accurate 3D models of mine surfaces and openings
Recording of the mine survey field books here
questions.solution: Creates accurate 3D models of surfaces and openings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stowing is not suitable when
options: The goaf area is not accessible or the seam is too thin
The seam is very thick in the whole of the coal mine area here
The mine is highly mechanised in the area here
In any of the mine working conditions here
questions.solution: When goaf is not accessible or seam is too thin.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'coal seam' is a
options: A type of the rock formation here
A type of the mineral deposit here
A single layer of the coal seam
Layer of coal between two layers of rock
questions.solution: A coal seam is a layer of coal between rock layers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'error of closure' in surveying is minimized by
options: Throwing away the field books
Ignoring the closure error of it
Rounding off the survey figures
Using precise instruments and methods
questions.solution: Closure errors are minimized by precise instruments and methods.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing records' must include
options: Stored only in the head office of the whole mine
The pressure rating of all the mine stowing pumps in the area here
The number of all the mine workers only there
Material quantity, water usage, filling progress, and issues
questions.solution: Records must include quantity, usage, progress, and issues.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When the winding engine is not in use, it must be
options: Removed from the winding house
Repaired and overhauled in mine
Left running idle in mine
Secured against unauthorized use
questions.solution: Secured against unauthorized use.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum number of shots a shot-firer may charge and fire in a shift in a gassy seam (first degree) belowground is:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 195: 40 shots in gassy seams belowground; 80 shots in other belowground and 100 in opencast workings per shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The stowing ratio refers to
options: The ratio of the mine sand to the stowing water used in the mine area
The ratio of stowing material to the volume of coal extracted
The ratio of the stowing dams to the mine galleries
The ratio of the mine fines to the coal seam here
questions.solution: Ratio of stowing material to coal extracted volume.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'dozer push' is used for
options: Drilling of the blast holes of the round
Pumping of the water from the mine pit
Long distance hauling of the coal on haul roads
Short-distance material movement on dumps
questions.solution: Dozer push is efficient for short-distance movement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The lighting in underground mines must be
options: Dim and inadequate for the whole underground mine workings area
Adequate for safe working and maintained in good condition
Fitted only in the surface mine office rooms
Confined to the bottom of the main mine shaft
questions.solution: Adequate for safe working and maintained in good condition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: SDL stands for
options: Side Discharge Loader
Single Drum Loader
Surface Dump Loader
Single Dump Loader
questions.solution: SDL stands for Side Discharge Loader.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main advantage of a belt conveyor over a rope haulage system is
options: The much less maintenance of the belts
No any such advantage at all in it
Continuous and higher capacity coal transport
A much lower operating cost of the belt
questions.solution: Continuous and higher capacity coal transport.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'collar pipe' in drifting prevents
options: Collapse of the borehole collar area
The air leakage in the drift face
The overloading of the mine pump
The water inflow in the mine sump
questions.solution: Collar pipes prevent borehole collar collapse.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'non-coking coal' is used for
options: The making of the coke in blast
Blending for coke making in blast furnaces
The smelting of the iron ore in blast
Power generation and industrial heating
questions.solution: Non-coking coal is used for power generation and heating.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'air distribution' in a mine must be such that
options: Every working face receives adequate fresh air
The main mine haulage roadway only here
All the air goes to one mine section
The working faces get no air at all
questions.solution: Every working face receives adequate fresh air.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The conveyor belt speed in underground mines is typically
options: 10 m/s
20 m/s
questions.solution: Typically 1-3 m/s.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'dewatering pump' in a mine must be of
options: Sufficient capacity to handle the anticipated water inflow
A very small pumping capacity in the underground mine area here
The same rating as the mine winding engine room
Any capacity that is available in the mine area
questions.solution: Sufficient capacity to handle anticipated water inflow.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'end effect' in shovel operation refers to
options: The final production of the ore
The end of the mine working life
The beginning of the mine shift
Reduced efficiency at ends of swing arc
questions.solution: End effect is reduced efficiency at swing arc ends.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sump capacity must be sufficient to
options: Any amount of the water that is inflowing here
The daily water requirement of the whole mine
Only half a day of the water inflow in the whole mine area here
Store water for at least one shift's inflow as a minimum
questions.solution: Store water for at least one shift's inflow.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The power cable used in underground mines must have
options: The plain aluminium wires of the mine area
Rated for the domestic power supply of the whole mine area
The plain twisted pair of the wires in mine
Armored construction with flame-retardant properties
questions.solution: Armored construction with flame-retardant properties.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'raise boring' machine is used to
options: Cutting of the mine timber supports
Driving the main mine haulage roadway
Excavate vertical or steep raises mechanically
Boring the deep water wells on the surface
questions.solution: Excavates vertical or steep raises mechanically.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A battery-operated locomotive in mines is used for
options: Haulage of coal and materials underground
Hoisting the persons in the mine shaft
Winding the hoisting ropes of it
Charging of the battery banks in mine
questions.solution: Haulage of coal and materials underground.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'leveling' in mine surveying determines
options: The pressure of the air in the mine
The temperature of the mine air there
The horizontal distance of the line
Difference in elevation between points
questions.solution: Leveling determines elevation differences between points.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'levelling staff' readings are taken to determine
options: The horizontal angle of the mine survey traverse line in the area
The bearing of the mine survey line in the area
The rate of the levelling staff graduations here
The elevation difference between instrument and staff point
questions.solution: Elevation difference between instrument and staff point.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stone dusting is done in underground coal mines to
options: Reduce the temperature of the mine air
Increase the output of the coal cutter
Reduce the risk of coal dust explosion
Reduce the cost of mine ventilation
questions.solution: Stone dusting reduces the risk of coal dust explosion.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'domino theory' of accident causation was proposed by
options: H.W. Heinrich
Bird
Petersen
James Reason
questions.solution: H.W. Heinrich proposed the domino theory.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gob' in mining is another term for
options: Longwall - the retreating face working
Stope - the vertical extraction opening
Goaf - the area where coal has been extracted
Cross-cut - the connecting roadway
questions.solution: Goaf - area where coal has been extracted.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a shot-firer must hold, in addition to a gas-testing certificate:
options: An Overman's or Sirdar's certificate
A mine Manager's First Class certificate only
An Engine Driver's certificate only
A mine Surveyor's certificate
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 190: a shot-firer holds a gas-testing certificate and an Overman's or Sirdar's certificate.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'face advance rate' depends on
options: The colour of the coal seam of the mine
The number of the working mine benches here
Blast results, material handling capacity, weather
The type of the mine winding rope of the main mine cage
questions.solution: Face advance depends on blasting efficiency, capacity, and conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, 'working in a mine' includes
options: The blasting and firing operations of the whole underground mine area
All operations including prospecting, development, and working
The transport of the coal in the underground mine area
The surface workshops of the whole mine area here
questions.solution: All operations including prospecting, development, and working.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An explosion-proof electrical equipment is used in mines to
options: To operate at a much higher mine voltage level in the mine here
To reduce the cost of the mine maintenance work
Prevent ignition of coal dust and methane by electrical sparks
To permit its use in a gassy coal mine heading
questions.solution: Prevents ignition of coal dust and methane.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A transformer in a mine is used to
options: The winding resistance testing
To amplify the electric current
Step up or step down voltage as required
To store the electrical energy
questions.solution: Steps up or steps down voltage as required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine must not be operated by a person who
options: Has a valid certificate only
Has no any experience at all
Is under the influence of intoxicants
Is above the age of eighteen years
questions.solution: Persons under the influence of intoxicants must not operate winding engines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cemented stowing' or 'paste fill' uses
options: The dry sand only in the mixture
The stone dust and the water only
A cement-based mixture for stronger support
The coal fines alone in the mixture
questions.solution: Cement-based mixture for stronger support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Inundation in underground mines occurs when
options: Water floods into mine workings from surface or underground sources
The roof of the underground mine working areas fall down suddenly
The firedamp gas accumulates in all the underground mine goaf areas only
No any water at all is present in the mine workings
questions.solution: Inundation is flooding of mine workings from water sources.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The accident statistics help in
options: Fix the output target of the whole coal mining district area here
Identifying trends, patterns, and areas for safety improvement
To reduce the mine equipment maintenance costs
Compare the output of the different mine shifts
questions.solution: Identifying trends, patterns, and areas for safety improvement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'breathing apparatus' used by mine rescue teams is called
options: A simple ordinary cloth face dust mask of it
The compressed air hose from the whole surface mine area here
Self-contained breathing apparatus (BG-174 or equivalent)
An oxygen cylinder with an open face mask of it
questions.solution: Self-contained breathing apparatus (BG-174 or equivalent).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'goaf management' in longwall mining involves
options: Filling the goaf with the pumped slurry
Ventilating the whole mine goaf area here
Controlling roof collapse behind the advancing face
Driving a cross cut through the whole of the mine goaf area
questions.solution: Controlling roof collapse behind advancing face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stone dust barriers are designed to
options: Arrest the explosion pressure wave
Prevent the dust accumulation in mine
Increase the incombustible content of roadway dust
Be triggered by the explosion pressure wave
questions.solution: Designed to be triggered by the explosion pressure wave.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing pump' in hydraulic stowing must have
options: No any specific requirement of the mine stowing pump at all
The same rating as the ventilation fan of it
Sufficient pressure and capacity to transport material
The low pressure of the stowing pump in mine
questions.solution: Pumps must have adequate pressure and capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: During examination in a fiery seam, the sirdar is required to carry:
options: A portable gas detector device of the mine area
A waterproof mine electric torch in the underground working face area
An approved flame safety lamp and a carbon monoxide detector
An electric torch of the very good make in the mine
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: where there is danger of fire or accumulation of gas, the sirdar carries an approved flame safety lamp and a carbon monoxide detector.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water logged working' in mines refers to
options: A well ventilated working place
A completely dry working place
Working that has been flooded with water
A newly developed working place
questions.solution: Water logged workings are those flooded with water.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: For charging and stemming shot-holes, the tools used by the shot-firer shall be:
options: Wooden implements and a scraper of brass or wood
The iron rods and the steel scrapers
The steel implements and tools only here
The PVC implements and the metal scrapers in the hole
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 197: only wooden implements and a brass or wooden scraper are used, to avoid sparks.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: If a sirdar's district is of such a size that it cannot be examined within the required time, the matter is referred to:
options: The manager
The overman
The safety officer
The Chief Inspector
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: if the district is too large to be examined in time, the matter is referred to the Chief Inspector for a decision.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A powered roof support (chock) is used in
options: To support the conveyor belts
To hold up the coal stock
Transport coal to the surface
Longwall mining for face support
questions.solution: Used in longwall mining for face support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Before firing in belowground workings, the shot-firer shall test for inflammable gas within a radius of at least:
options: 5 m
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 198: the shot-firer tests the strata and the surrounding area for gas within a radius of 18 m before firing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'load cell' in strata monitoring measures
options: Load on support elements
Air velocity
Gas concentration
Temperature
questions.solution: Load cells measure load on support elements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The transformer room in a mine must be
options: Fire-resistant, ventilated, and properly maintained
It is placed in the underground area only
Any room of the mine surface premises here
For the current transformation of the mine power supply only
questions.solution: Fire-resistant, ventilated, and properly maintained.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bench face angle' depends on
options: The colour of the rock strata of the mine
The number of the mine dump trucks there
Rock mass properties, joint orientation, groundwater
The type of the drilling machine that is used in the mine area
questions.solution: Bench face angle depends on geological conditions.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: 'Safety' is related to 'Helmet' in the same way as 'Fire' is related to ?
options: Smoke
Heat
Extinguisher
Water
questions.solution: Safety is protected by helmet, fire is controlled by extinguisher.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Sagarmala' project is related to
options: The rural electrification of the area
The river linking project of the state
The solar power mission of the state
Port-led development and coastal economic zones
questions.solution: Port-led development.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which is the longest river in India?
options: Yamuna
Godavari
Ganga
Narmada
questions.solution: Ganga is the longest river flowing through India.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Quit India Movement' was launched in which year?
questions.solution: Quit India Movement was launched in 1942.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Coal Controller's Organization' is under
options: The DGMS office
The IBM office
The CIL office
Ministry of Coal
questions.solution: Under Ministry of Coal.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal supply chain' from mine to consumer includes
options: The geological exploration stage alone
The transport stage from pit to plant alone
The washing and despatch stages alone
Extraction, processing, transport, and dispatch
questions.solution: Extraction, processing, transport, and dispatch.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'continuous miner' technology in India has been adopted from
options: It is developed locally in each of the underground mine areas here
It has no particular source of any origin at all
International manufacturers and adapted for Indian conditions
From the surface coal mining machines only here
questions.solution: International manufacturers, adapted for India.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'national coal distribution policy' ensures
options: Equitable allocation of coal to various sectors
The reservation of the coal for the power sector
Free supply to the local industries
A total ban on the export of the coal
questions.solution: Equitable allocation to various sectors.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Rihand Dam' and power station are located in
options: Bihar
Madhya Pradesh
Uttar Pradesh
Jharkhand
questions.solution: Located in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The father of the Indian nation is
options: Subhas Chandra Bose
Mahatma Gandhi
Sardar Patel
Jawaharlal Nehru
questions.solution: Mahatma Gandhi is the father of the nation.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If the ratio of A's salary to B's salary is 3:5 and B's salary is Rs 40,000, what is A's salary?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Area of triangle: base 10cm, height 8cm?
options: 60 cm²
80 cm²
100 cm²
40 cm²

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'afforestation' on mined-out areas helps in
options: Carbon sequestration and environmental restoration
Increasing the coal output of the mine
Raising the height of the surface mine dump heaps in area
Promoting the coal exports of the mine
questions.solution: Carbon sequestration and restoration.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'dewatering' in coal mines is important to
options: Remove groundwater for safe working conditions
Increase the calorific value of the mine coal
Reduce the cost of the mine ventilation
Increase the moisture in the coal seam here
questions.solution: Dewatering removes groundwater for safe working.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Qutub Minar is made of
options: Granite stone
Red sandstone and marble
White marble only
Baked bricks only
questions.solution: Qutub Minar is made of red sandstone and marble.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' scheme promotes
options: Girl child education and welfare
The coal mine automation work here
The highway development work here
Urban transport projects
questions.solution: Girl child education and welfare.
